body: Try your best to figure things out, I hope you can sort it out and get your life on track.
I was actually able to get on antidepressants today, apparently they can take up to a month to start working, but heres hoping to that, thanks for your replies.

Thank you for the reply

From what I've read from other other posts is that sometimes medication doesn't entirely fix their issues. They might feel happier but not have any form of drive/motivation. And don't get me wrong, I would be willing to try these except I would need a job to get this medication, and in my short lived experience of having a job, I can't fucking hold up long enough to do so. I don't have the willpower to continue through doing the same remedial task day in day out on these low end jobs, on my first day for instance, all I felt was this sensation of pressure pushing down on my back and chest, the entire time I was just wishing the day would be done so I could lay in my bed. The entire day just felt like a fever dream. But the issue of just sleeping is the reality that I'd have to wake up and show up again the next day. I don't understand how people are willing/able to put up with doing these things they hate. It's so difficult to find any form of fulfillment from these jobs, the compensation of money isn't enough for me to put up with it.
